narrative.details: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
narrative.objectives: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.

Oh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
narrative.endText: Escort Wizzlecrank out of the Venture Co. drill site
